# Chart.js

Pinned Chart.js 4.5.1 UMD bundle, served locally only on the admin dashboard.

- Upstream: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/releases/tag/v4.5.1
- Bundle source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- License: MIT, preserved in `Chart.js-LICENSE.md` and the bundle header.
- Removed the source-map trailer because the map is not shipped.
